The '''SFS L-s7.2 laser cannon''' were mass produced in the [[Wakeelmui system/Legends|Wakeelmui system]], and were considered the standard [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] used on [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]{{'s}} [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] around the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Description==
The SFS L-s7.2 offered a low recycle time meaning higher rates of fire. It improved on the [[L-s1 laser cannon/Legends|L-s1 laser cannons]] power.

==History==
Besides being fitted onto TIE craft throughout the history of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a modified version of the weapon was used on [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|Chiss clawcraft]].
